title: A Court of Silver Flames
author: Sarah J. Maas
summary: After the war, a battered young woman in the series' Night Court tries to find a sense of purpose through training. She is paired with a grim, aloof warrior, and the book follows both of them as they confront old damage.
readIf: you want a steamy, character-focused entry that follows trauma, training and a slow-building romance.
skipIf: you want the high-stakes plot of the earlier books, or are bothered by very explicit scenes.

pairings.reason: The book that comes before it, with more political drama and the larger war storyline.
Another romantasy with a training setting, a hard-edged hero and a lot of physical danger.
The same author in a modern-meets-fantasy world with a wounded heroine and a slow-burn romance.
